title: Provider & Lifecycle Authority
base_requirement: Apply on top of the current tree containing REMED-R02A v2, REMED-R02B v2, and REMED-R02 whole-scope audit hotfix.

delivered_findings.evidence: apply_cleanup_plan() refreshes cleanup ownership with strict authority reads and raises CleanupAuthorityUnavailableError before mutation when RUN/RER, artifact-registry, active transaction, or active validation protection authority is corrupt/unreadable.

partial_findings.evidence: Normal SSH provider phase metadata now carries RUN/LIFE lifecycle authority, cleanup descriptor count, and cleanup descriptor digest derived from provider_cleanup_descriptors(). R03B still owns universal retention/GC enforcement and reference-release semantics.

production_ingress_changed: cleanup_lifecycle.apply_cleanup_plan strict cleanup-authority refresh before destructive mutation
distributed_provider_control.ssh_phase_dist_metadata lifecycle-authority digest/count for normal SSH provider phases
oci_resilience.phase_metadata_lines public RUN/LIFE lifecycle authority key survives redaction
v2_audit_corrections: Active transaction markers are verified in strict cleanup mode before find_active_transactions() can prune malformed markers.
Corrupt active validation markers are translated into CleanupAuthorityUnavailableError during strict cleanup refresh.
Added adversarial tests for corrupt transaction marker and corrupt validation marker fail-closed behavior.
